sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Several months ago, I noticed one of my colleagues taking breaks from work during the day.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我注意到我的一位同事在白天工作时会休息。

sentences.en: At first, I thought Max Nestrack was trying to build some exercise into his schedule.
sentences.zh: 起初，我以为马克斯·内斯特拉克是想在日程中增加一些锻炼。

sentences.en: Good for him, I thought.
sentences.zh: 我心想，这对他有好处。

sentences.en: But when I asked him about it, he confessed that he was stepping outside to smoke.
sentences.zh: 但当我问起时，他坦白说他是出去抽烟了。

sentences.en: We did a podcast episode about New Year's resolutions
sentences.zh: 我们做了一期关于新年决心播客节目，

sentences.en: and Max's resolution to quit smoking at the start of the year.
sentences.zh: 也谈到了马克斯年初戒烟的决心。

sentences.en: It's 2016, and I have not smoked for two minutes.
sentences.zh: 现在是2016年，我两分钟没抽烟了。

sentences.en: Lots of you have written and phoned and emailed to ask how Max is doing
sentences.zh: 你们很多人写信、打电话和发邮件来询问马克斯的情况，

sentences.en: and whether he's managed to stick to his resolution.
sentences.zh: 以及他是否成功坚持了自己的决心。

sentences.en: Ah, I really want a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 啊，我真的好想抽根烟。

sentences.en: Yeah, about that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关于那个嘛。

sentences.en: We'll get to it in a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们几分钟后再谈。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to talk about Max's story
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要聊聊马克斯的故事，

sentences.en: and three interventions I suggested to help him quit smoking.
sentences.zh: 以及我建议他用来戒烟的三种干预措施。

sentences.en: You can apply these ideas in your own life,
sentences.zh: 你可以将这些想法应用到你自己的生活中，

sentences.en: whether that's giving up smoking or that three latte a day Starbucks habit.
sentences.zh: 无论是戒烟还是戒掉每天三杯星巴克拿铁的习惯。

sentences.en: When Max decided to quit, he and I sat down to chat.
sentences.zh: 当马克斯决定戒烟时，我们坐下来聊了聊。

sentences.en: I asked him how he became a smoker and what cigarettes meant to him.
sentences.zh: 我问他是如何成为烟民的，以及香烟对他意味着什么。

sentences.en: So you told me that you started smoking when you were 14 or 15 years old.
sentences.zh: 你告诉我，你是在14或15岁时开始抽烟的。

sentences.en: That seems shockingly young to me.
sentences.zh: 这在我看来小得惊人。

sentences.en: It seems shockingly young to me, too.
sentences.zh: 在我看来也小得惊人。

sentences.en: I should say the first cigarette I actually smoked,
sentences.zh: 我应该说，我真正抽的第一支烟，

sentences.en: I was 10 years old.
sentences.zh: 我当时才10岁。

sentences.en: It was Christmas, and my aunt smoked, so they would be on the back patio,
sentences.zh: 那是圣诞节，我阿姨抽烟，所以他们会待在后院露台上，

sentences.en: you know, shivering outside.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在外面瑟瑟发抖。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm like, I wonder what it's like to smoke a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 然后，我就想，不知道抽烟是什么感觉。

sentences.en: My dad was like, sure, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸说，当然，去吧。

sentences.en: Join Aunt Doe and, you know, Cousin Jenny and have a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 加入多伊阿姨和珍妮表姐，抽根烟吧。

sentences.en: And so I went outside, and I had a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 于是我走到外面，抽了一支烟。

sentences.en: And I think his hope was that, you know, I would just vomit
sentences.zh: 我想他的希望是，我只会呕吐，

sentences.en: or just get so sick that I would never do it again
sentences.zh: 或者难受得再也不碰它了，

sentences.en: because you never, you know, you never touch cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 因为你永远、你知道，你永远不该碰香烟。

sentences.en: But, you know, I never did, and I, you know, it didn't really have an effect.
sentences.zh: 但我从来没吐过，而且，它对我没产生什么影响。

sentences.en: Did you like it?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢吗？

sentences.en: I was a little buzzed.
sentences.zh: 我有点飘飘然。

sentences.en: I did like it.
sentences.zh: 我确实喜欢。

sentences.en: I thought I liked it.
sentences.zh: 我以为我喜欢它。

sentences.en: I mean, I liked, you know, being there, like, with my family outside smoking.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我喜欢和家人待在外面抽烟的那种感觉。

sentences.en: I felt kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己挺酷的。

sentences.en: And all the other cousins who were my age were kind of, like,
sentences.zh: 而其他和我同龄的表亲们，就像是，

sentences.en: peering out of the patio behind the glass door,
sentences.zh: 隔着玻璃门从露台往外窥视，

sentences.en: the safety of the non-smoking kitchen nook.
sentences.zh: 待在禁烟厨房角落的安全地带。

sentences.en: And I'm just like, what is Max doing?
sentences.zh: 我当时就在想，马克斯在干什么？

sentences.en: And there I was in my coat huddling with the other ostracized family member smokers.
sentences.zh: 而我穿着外套，和其他被排挤的吸烟家人挤在一起。

sentences.en: What did your mom say about this?
sentences.zh: 你妈妈对此怎么说？

sentences.en: My mom, I think, rolled her eyes, and she was like,
sentences.zh: 我想我妈翻了个白眼，她说，

sentences.en: I can't believe your dad said this was okay, but I hope you vomit too.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信你爸会同意，但我希望你也吐出来。

sentences.en: But as Max said, he didn't vomit.
sentences.zh: 但正如马克斯所说，他没有呕吐。

sentences.en: In fact, he liked smoking.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他喜欢上了抽烟。

sentences.en: A few years later, when he was a freshman in high school,
sentences.zh: 几年后，当他上高一的时候，

sentences.en: he asked an older friend to buy him a pack of cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 他让一个年长的朋友帮他买了一包烟。

sentences.en: He began smoking regularly.
sentences.zh: 他开始定期抽烟。

sentences.en: I used to take the dog on walks, and that was, like, my smoke break.
sentences.zh: 我过去常带狗去散步，那就是我的抽烟休息时间。

sentences.en: And so I think, you know, starting around age, you know, 14,
sentences.zh: 所以我想，从14岁左右开始，

sentences.en: that dog got so many walks a day.
sentences.zh: 那只狗每天散步的次数就变得特别多。

sentences.en: Or, like, it got increasingly more exercise as the years went on.
sentences.zh: 或者说，随着时间的推移，它得到的锻炼越来越多。

sentences.en: So a scientist would say there was an inverse relationship between the dog's health and your health.
sentences.zh: 所以科学家会说，狗的健康状况和你的健康状况之间存在反比关系。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes, I think that's an apt description.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是一个贴切的描述。

sentences.en: As he's gotten older, Max says he's become aware of the stigma around smoking.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄增长，马克斯说他开始意识到围绕吸烟的污名。

sentences.en: It didn't stop him, but it did make him think twice about telling friends and coworkers about his habit.
sentences.zh: 这并没有阻止他，但确实让他对告诉朋友和同事自己的习惯感到顾虑。

sentences.en: I don't think it makes me cooler or more interesting.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这让我更酷或更有趣。

sentences.en: And generally, I think when I first meet people, I'm not afraid of being judged,
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，当我第一次见到别人时，我不怕被评判，

sentences.en: but it's just something that's, like, yeah, it's not something I just want to share right off the bat.
sentences.zh: 但这只是，嗯，这不是我想立刻分享的事情。

sentences.en: But if there's a social stigma to smoking, there are also social benefits.
sentences.zh: 但如果吸烟有社会污名，它也有社会益处。

sentences.en: One thing Max and I discussed was the smoker's club that forms outside of offices and libraries.
sentences.zh: 马克斯和我讨论的一件事是办公室和图书馆外形成的“烟民俱乐部”。

sentences.en: You see the same people congregating every day, chatting as they smoke.
sentences.zh: 你每天都会看到同样的人聚在一起，边抽烟边聊天。

sentences.en: I mean, that's very profound, psychologically speaking.
sentences.zh: 我是说，从心理学角度来看，这非常深刻。

sentences.en: If you're constantly meeting people only at the times that you're doing something that you enjoy,
sentences.zh: 如果你总是只在做自己喜欢的事情时遇到某些人，

sentences.en: those are people you're going to associate in a Pavlovian fashion with the thing that you enjoy.
sentences.zh: 那么你就会以巴甫洛夫的方式将这些人与你喜欢的事情联系起来。

sentences.en: You're going to be forming friendships with them, and now the friendships keep you in that world.
sentences.zh: 你会与他们建立友谊，而现在这些友谊让你留在了那个世界里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think it's the same with activities.
sentences.zh: 我认为活动也是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, the more you smoke, the better life gets in a way.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在某种程度上，抽烟越多，生活就越美好。

sentences.en: I mean, smoking and television, smoking and eating breakfast, smoking and eating ice cream.
sentences.zh: 我是说，抽烟配电视，抽烟配早餐，抽烟配冰淇淋。

sentences.en: But I think that's true with people, that there is, like, this shared bond where you're out on the break,
sentences.zh: 但我认为人也是如此，有一种共同的纽带，当你们在休息时，

sentences.en: and, right, the pleasure center is being activated and while you're talking,
sentences.zh: 没错，快乐中心被激活了，当你们在交谈时，

sentences.en: so you probably think, you know, the conversation is better.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会觉得，谈话内容更好了。

sentences.en: I think it's the same as when people go out to the bar at a happy hour together and they have drinks.
sentences.zh: 我认为这和人们一起去酒吧参加欢乐时光喝酒是一样的。

sentences.en: So there's this bond that's formed that just wouldn't be formed at work or on the water cooler in a way.
sentences.zh: 所以形成了一种在工作或饮水机旁无法形成的纽带。

sentences.en: There are other clubs you get to join when you're a smoker.
sentences.zh: 当你成为烟民时，还有其他俱乐部可以加入。

sentences.en: But, of course, smokers like Max tend not to think of those clubs when they're smoking.
sentences.zh: 但当然，像马克斯这样的烟民在抽烟时往往不会想到那些俱乐部。

sentences.en: With smoking, I associate myself with the film noir, the cigarette after dinner, the social smoking,
sentences.zh: 对于吸烟，我联想到的是黑色电影、晚餐后的香烟、社交吸烟，

sentences.en: but not the emphysema or lung cancer or oxygen mask part of the game, if you will.
sentences.zh: 而不是肺气肿、肺癌或氧气面罩，如果你懂的话。

sentences.en: So that's the interesting thing, of course.
sentences.zh: 所以这当然很有趣。

sentences.en: And you know all the social science literature on this,
sentences.zh: 而且你知道所有关于这方面的社会科学文献，

sentences.en: which is that the pleasure and the social camaraderie and the friendships are real and immediate,
sentences.zh: 那就是快乐、社会友谊和友情是真实且即时的，

sentences.en: and the potential costs are delayed and distant.
sentences.zh: 而潜在的代价是延迟且遥远的。

sentences.en: And there's just six warehouses filled with psych studies that basically show that when you set up the incentives this way
sentences.zh: 有六个仓库装满了心理学研究，基本上表明当你这样设置激励机制时，

sentences.en: so that the short-term incentives are positive and gratifying and the long-term incentives are horrible,
sentences.zh: 即短期激励是积极和令人满足的，而长期激励是可怕的，

sentences.en: people will ignore the long-term and focus on the short-term.
sentences.zh: 人们会忽略长期影响而专注于短期。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think there's never a good day to quit smoking, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，我想戒烟从来没有一个好日子，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, there's the part of yourself that wants to wake up at 6 o'clock in the morning,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你内心有一部分想在早上6点醒来，

sentences.en: and so you set the alarm clock.
sentences.zh: 所以你设置了闹钟。

sentences.en: Like, the youth at 6 o'clock in the morning presses the snooze button 20 times until it's 8 o'clock,
sentences.zh: 就像早上6点的那个年轻人按了20次贪睡按钮直到8点，

sentences.en: and then you're rushing to work, and you're late.
sentences.zh: 然后你匆忙赶去上班，结果迟到了。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's the part of myself at night who says,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我内心在晚上有一部分说，

sentences.en: OK, tomorrow I'm going to stop smoking, and then you wake up and you have one,
sentences.zh: 好吧，明天我要戒烟，然后你醒来又抽了一根，

sentences.en: and then you're like, well, if I had one, I'm not going to go the rest of the day without smoking.
sentences.zh: 然后你会想，好吧，既然已经抽了一根，那今天剩下的时间就不戒了。

sentences.en: And so it's easy to weigh the long-term benefits of smoking when you're not craving a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 所以当你没有烟瘾时，很容易权衡戒烟的长期好处。

sentences.en: An old smoker's joke says, quitting is easy.
sentences.zh: 一个老烟民的笑话说，戒烟很容易。

sentences.en: I've done it lots of times.
sentences.zh: 我已经戒过很多次了。

sentences.en: Knowing that most people who quit go back to smoking,
sentences.zh: 鉴于大多数戒烟的人又会复吸，

sentences.en: I suggested that Max do three things to help him stick to his resolution.
sentences.zh: 我建议马克斯做三件事来帮助他坚持自己的决心。

sentences.en: All were ideas drawn from social science research.
sentences.zh: 所有这些想法都来自社会科学研究。

sentences.en: First, I asked him to put the money he was spending on smoking, about $6 a day, into a savings account.
sentences.zh: 首先，我让他把花在抽烟上的钱，每天大约6美元，存入储蓄账户。

sentences.en: If he succeeded in quitting at the end of the year, he would be able to go on a nice vacation.
sentences.zh: 如果他在年底成功戒烟，他就能去度个愉快的假。

sentences.en: But if he started smoking, he would have to donate the money to an organization he detests.
sentences.zh: 但如果他开始抽烟，他就必须把钱捐给他厌恶的组织。

sentences.en: Now, I'm not going to identify it, but let's just say Max picked an organization that does a lot of lobbying in Washington.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不会指名道姓，但只能说马克斯选了一个在华盛顿进行大量游说的组织。

sentences.en: Second, I asked him to reach out to a bunch of friends and asked them to be there for him when he needed support.
sentences.zh: 其次，我让他联系一群朋友，请他们在需要支持时陪伴他。

sentences.en: And finally, I asked him to record a public service announcement about why young people should never start smoking.
sentences.zh: 最后，我让他录制了一段公益广告，讲述年轻人为什么永远不该开始抽烟。

sentences.en: The idea is that when you publicly declare you're against smoking, it makes it hard to start smoking again.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，当你公开宣布反对吸烟时，就很难再开始抽烟了。

sentences.en: It produces cognitive dissonance, makes you feel like a hypocrite.
sentences.zh: 这会产生认知失调，让你觉得自己是个伪君子。

sentences.en: We aired Max's public service announcement in January.
sentences.zh: 我们在1月份播出了马克斯的公益广告。

sentences.en: Here's an excerpt.
sentences.zh: 这是节选。

sentences.en: If you don't smoke, here's what you should know.
sentences.zh: 如果你不抽烟，你应该知道这些。

sentences.en: When you're a smoker, life is lived around cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 当你是个烟民时，生活是围绕着香烟展开的。

sentences.en: You'll be laughing with friends at dinner or totally engrossed in a good book, and something will tug at you.
sentences.zh: 你会和朋友在晚餐时大笑，或者完全沉浸在一本好书中，然后有什么东西会拉扯你。

sentences.en: And as much as you want to stay in this moment, you'll be thinking about a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 无论你多么想留在这一刻，你都会想着抽根烟。

sentences.en: So you'll get up, walk outside, and light up.
sentences.zh: 所以你会起身，走到外面，点上一根。

sentences.en: And it will feel really good.
sentences.zh: 感觉确实很好。

sentences.en: But you'll wish you were back inside, and you'll be so tired of trading off these moments for a smoke.
sentences.zh: 但你会希望自己还在里面，你会厌倦为了抽烟而牺牲这些时刻。

sentences.en: If you don't smoke, you should know that smoking makes a prison out of perfectly normal situations.
sentences.zh: 如果你不抽烟，你应该知道吸烟会让原本正常的场合变成监狱。

sentences.en: Long flights, concerts, class, anything that lasts longer than a couple of hours, these are your enemy as a smoker.
sentences.zh: 长途飞行、音乐会、上课，任何持续超过几个小时的事情，对烟民来说都是敌人。

sentences.en: And any time you go on a date, or to a job interview, or to your grandparents' house, it will be accompanied by a pang of worry.
sentences.zh: 任何时候你去约会、面试或去祖父母家，都会伴随着一阵焦虑。

sentences.en: You'll wash your hands and pull your shirt to your nose, and hope they can't smell smoke.
sentences.zh: 你会洗手，把衬衫拉到鼻子前，希望他们闻不到烟味。

sentences.en: We also asked something from all of you.
sentences.zh: 我们也向你们所有人提出了一个请求。

sentences.en: We asked that you call in with your own stories about how you managed to quit smoking.
sentences.zh: 我们请你们打来电话，分享你们自己成功戒烟的故事。

sentences.en: We were absolutely overwhelmed and moved by your responses.
sentences.zh: 你们的回应让我们感到无比震撼和感动。

sentences.en: So many of you wrote and called with words of wisdom and encouragement.
sentences.zh: 你们中有许多人写信和打电话来表达智慧和鼓励的话语。

sentences.en: Hi, this message is for Max.
sentences.zh: 嗨，这条信息是给马克斯的。

sentences.en: I was just on my way home listening to the Resolutions podcast,
sentences.zh: 我刚才在回家的路上听《决心》播客，

sentences.en: and I was actually on the way home from my dad having surgery on his lungs for lung cancer.
sentences.zh: 我其实刚从我爸爸做肺癌手术的医院回来。

sentences.en: So I just wanted to wish Max good luck, and hopefully he's able to quit,
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想祝马克斯好运，希望他能戒烟成功，

sentences.en: and this isn't him in 50 years.
sentences.zh: 这样50年后他就不会变成这样。

sentences.en: My dad is 74.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸74岁了。

sentences.en: There's no need to badmouth the old self, but best to nurture the new direction with as many creative ways as you can come up with.
sentences.zh: 没有必要诋毁过去的自己，但最好用你能想到的各种创造性方式来培养新的方向。

sentences.en: I have no doubt you will succeed.
sentences.zh: 我毫不怀疑你会成功。

sentences.en: It's been 28 years since the day I quit.
sentences.zh: 我戒烟已经28年了。

sentences.en: The thing that really helped me was not to focus on the whole project, but on the steps.
sentences.zh: 真正帮助我的是不要关注整个项目，而是关注每一步。

sentences.en: For instance, I kept repeating me every time I had the urge of going out and smoking a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 例如，每次我有冲动想出去抽烟时，我都会不断对自己重复。

sentences.en: Well, this one, you're not going to smoke it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这一根，你不能抽。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I just concentrated my attention and my power on the single cigarette that I was craving.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，我只是把注意力和力量集中在我想抽的那一支烟上。

sentences.en: And that way, cigarette by cigarette, I successfully quit it.
sentences.zh: 就这样，一支接一支，我成功戒掉了。

sentences.en: I threw out my cigarettes, and in that moment I decided that not only was I going to quit smoking,
sentences.zh: 我扔掉了香烟，在那一刻我决定，我不仅要戒烟，

sentences.en: but that I would become a non-smoker right then.
sentences.zh: 而且从那一刻起我就要成为一个不抽烟的人。

sentences.en: And from then on, every time I would want a cigarette,
sentences.zh: 从那以后，每次我想抽烟时，

sentences.en: I would ask myself why in the world a non-smoker would want a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 我都会问自己，一个不抽烟的人为什么会想抽烟呢？

sentences.en: Go to the places where you usually buy cigarettes,
sentences.zh: 去你平时买烟的地方，

sentences.en: and introduce yourself to the person behind the counter,
sentences.zh: 向柜台后的店员做个自我介绍，

sentences.en: and just let them know that you're trying to stop smoking.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们你正在尝试戒烟。

sentences.en: You don't have to tell them not to sell you cigarettes or anything like that,
sentences.zh: 你不需要让他们别卖烟给你之类的，

sentences.en: but just say to them that you're trying to stop smoking.
sentences.zh: 只要告诉他们你正在尝试戒烟就行。

sentences.en: It's going to be really hard for you to then go back there and buy cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 这样之后你再回去买烟时，会觉得非常难为情。

sentences.en: We're going to take a break now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在休息一下。

sentences.en: Now, when we come back, we're going to hear from Max.
sentences.zh: 回来之后，我们将听听 Max 的分享。

sentences.en: He kept an audio diary as he went along to document his triumphs and setbacks.
sentences.zh: 他在戒烟过程中录制了音频日记，记录下自己的成功与挫折。

sentences.en: It's like this mental obsession.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种精神上的强迫症。

sentences.en: So you're kind of like, oh, should I have a granola bar?
sentences.zh: 你会想，哦，我是不是该吃根燕麦棒？

sentences.en: No, I want to have a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 不，我想抽根烟。

sentences.en: Should I go for a walk?
sentences.zh: 我是不是该去散散步？

sentences.en: No, I want to have a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 不，我想抽根烟。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: Quitting smoking is kind of like a really bad breakup.
sentences.zh: 戒烟就像经历一场糟糕的分手。

sentences.en: At first, I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 起初，我还好。

sentences.en: I feel relieved, happy even, that I finally did it.
sentences.zh: 我感到如释重负，甚至很高兴自己终于做到了。

sentences.en: This isn't so bad.
sentences.zh: 这也没那么难嘛。

sentences.en: I go to bed that night looking forward to waking up the next day as a new person.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我上床睡觉，期待着第二天醒来能成为一个全新的自己。

sentences.en: Tomorrow is January 1st, 2016.
sentences.zh: 明天就是2016年1月1日了。

sentences.en: It's going to be the first day of the rest of my so much better life.
sentences.zh: 这将是我余生中更美好生活的第一天。

sentences.en: Of course, the first thing I think about when I wake up is a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 当然，我醒来时想到的第一件事就是抽烟。

sentences.en: I plan to go downstairs and pour myself a cup of coffee, bundle up in my winter coat,
sentences.zh: 我计划下楼给自己倒杯咖啡，裹上冬装，

sentences.en: and have the first cigarette of the day.
sentences.zh: 然后抽上一天里的第一根烟。

sentences.en: Which is, as any smoker will tell you, the best cigarette of the day.
sentences.zh: 正如任何烟民都会告诉你的，这是全天最爽的一根烟。

sentences.en: Then I remember what I'd done.
sentences.zh: 然后我想起了自己做过的事。

sentences.en: Said I would quit smoking.
sentences.zh: 我说过我要戒烟。

sentences.en: And I do not stop remembering it.
sentences.zh: 而且我一直没忘。

sentences.en: I started keeping an audio diary.
sentences.zh: 我开始写音频日记。

sentences.en: Here's a clip.
sentences.zh: 这是其中的一段。

sentences.en: It's just, it's like this mental obsession.
sentences.zh: 这真的，就像是一种精神上的强迫症。

sentences.en: So you're kind of like, oh, should I have a granola bar?
sentences.zh: 你会想，哦，我是不是该吃根燕麦棒？

sentences.en: No, I want to have a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 不，我想抽根烟。

sentences.en: Should I go for a walk?
sentences.zh: 我是不是该去散散步？

sentences.en: No, I want to have a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 不，我想抽根烟。

sentences.en: Should I watch a movie?
sentences.zh: 我是不是该看部电影？

sentences.en: No, I want to have a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 不，我想抽根烟。

sentences.en: So that's, it's just like this obsession.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就像是一种强迫症。

sentences.en: That's all you want.
sentences.zh: 你想要的只有这个。

sentences.en: And that's all you can think about.
sentences.zh: 你脑子里想的也只有这个。

sentences.en: I think back to the early days of the romance.
sentences.zh: 我回想起那段恋情的初期。

sentences.en: When I would get lightheaded, tingly in my fingers, and just feel giddy.
sentences.zh: 那时我会感到头晕目眩，手指发麻，整个人飘飘然。

sentences.en: I started smoking around the time I realized I was gay.
sentences.zh: 我大约是在意识到自己是同性恋的时候开始抽烟的。

sentences.en: I went to high school in suburban Colorado with a champion football team.
sentences.zh: 我在科罗拉多州的郊区读高中，那里有一支冠军橄榄球队。

sentences.en: And well, by the time I started smoking at 14, I needed it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到我14岁开始抽烟时，我确实需要它。

sentences.en: Sometimes I would inhale as much as I could, close my eyes,
sentences.zh: 有时我会尽可能深地吸一口，闭上眼睛，

sentences.en: and just let my head buzz while I held in the smoke.
sentences.zh: 屏住呼吸，任由大脑在烟雾中嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: The withdrawal feels like just the opposite.
sentences.zh: 戒断反应的感觉恰恰相反。

sentences.en: I'm sad and frustrated.
sentences.zh: 我感到悲伤和沮丧。

sentences.en: My headaches.
sentences.zh: 我头痛。

sentences.en: My muscles tighten up.
sentences.zh: 肌肉紧绷。

sentences.en: My thoughts are foggy.
sentences.zh: 思维变得迟钝。

sentences.en: I'm acutely aware that there's suffering in the world.
sentences.zh: 我敏锐地意识到这个世界上充满了苦难。

sentences.en: When you're having a craving, you just, you don't think that you're ever going to feel
sentences.zh: 当你烟瘾发作时，你根本不会觉得你会改变，

sentences.en: differently or have felt differently.
sentences.zh: 或者曾经有过不一样的感觉。

sentences.en: I try to embrace it.
sentences.zh: 我试着去拥抱这种感觉。

sentences.en: A craving comes, and I just lean into it.
sentences.zh: 烟瘾来了，我就顺应它。

sentences.en: You have to love the burn almoSt.
sentences.zh: 你几乎得爱上那种灼烧感。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, you, it sucks, it hurts, and you just kind of lean into it.
sentences.zh: 就是，这感觉很糟，很痛苦，但你只能顺应它。

sentences.en: And you're like, yeah, like, this is what quitting feels like.
sentences.zh: 你会想，没错，这就是戒烟的感觉。

sentences.en: And yeah, so I'm loving the burn right now.
sentences.zh: 没错，我现在很享受这种灼烧感。

sentences.en: I'm loving, hating the burn right now.
sentences.zh: 我既享受又痛恨这种灼烧感。

sentences.en: I'm chewing sugar-free gum and drinking seltzer water.
sentences.zh: 我嚼着无糖口香糖，喝着苏打水。

sentences.en: These are my sad romance song and cinnamon bun equivalents.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我悲伤恋曲和肉桂卷的替代品。

sentences.en: I bask in the pain and let my mind do what it wants to do.
sentences.zh: 我沉浸在痛苦中，任由大脑随心所欲。

sentences.en: Think about how much it sucks to not have a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 去想没烟抽是多么糟糕。

sentences.en: Then I think about something I heard about Buffalo.
sentences.zh: 然后我想起关于水牛的一件事。

sentences.en: That when Buffalo see a storm coming, they walk towards it rather than away from it
sentences.zh: 当水牛看到风暴来临时，它们会迎着风暴走，而不是逃离，

sentences.en: because they know they'll get through it faster.
sentences.zh: 因为它们知道这样能更快穿过风暴。

sentences.en: I am the Buffalo.
sentences.zh: 我就是那头水牛。

sentences.en: It's like three minutes away from being 48 hours, so it's at the end of day two.
sentences.zh: 再过三分钟就满48小时了，也就是第二天结束的时候。

sentences.en: There were some dark moments today.
sentences.zh: 今天经历了一些黑暗时刻。

sentences.en: I don't know if I can take another day of this.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己还能不能再忍受一天。

sentences.en: I think about the money I've saved on cigarettes that I'd have to donate to that horrible organization if I smoked.
sentences.zh: 我想到如果我抽烟，就得把省下的烟钱捐给那个糟糕的组织。

sentences.en: It's actually only $13.
sentences.zh: 其实也就13美元。

sentences.en: I think if I'm going to relapse, I should do it now while there's so little at stake.
sentences.zh: 我想如果非要复吸，现在代价这么小，不如就现在吧。

sentences.en: Then I think about having to say I failed on this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 然后我想到要在播客里承认自己失败了。

sentences.en: I Google quitting smoking timeline.
sentences.zh: 我用谷歌搜索了戒烟时间表。

sentences.en: After 20 minutes, your blood pressure and heart rate will return to normal.
sentences.zh: 20分钟后，血压和心率恢复正常。

sentences.en: After 12 hours, blood oxygen level has increased to normal.
sentences.zh: 12小时后，血液含氧量恢复正常。

sentences.en: 48 hours, damaged nerve endings start to regrow and anger and irritability have peaked.
sentences.zh: 48小时后，受损的神经末梢开始再生，愤怒和易怒情绪达到顶峰。

sentences.en: 72 hours, entire body is free of nicotine.
sentences.zh: 72小时后，体内尼古丁完全清除。

sentences.en: Number of cravings have peaked.
sentences.zh: 烟瘾发作次数达到顶峰。

sentences.en: Lung function is improving.
sentences.zh: 肺功能正在改善。

sentences.en: I make it to day three.
sentences.zh: 我坚持到了第三天。

sentences.en: I go for a run, and I'm surprised at how much my lungs have already recovered.
sentences.zh: 我去跑步，惊讶地发现肺部已经恢复了这么多。

sentences.en: The cravings come less frequently, just like the quitting smoking websites promise they will.
sentences.zh: 烟瘾发作的频率降低了，正如那些戒烟网站承诺的那样。

sentences.en: I'm nearly three weeks into quitting smoking now.
sentences.zh: 我戒烟快三周了。

sentences.en: It's day 20, and the most amazing thing happens.
sentences.zh: 今天是第20天，发生了一件最神奇的事。

sentences.en: I woke up, and I drank a glass of orange juice.
sentences.zh: 我醒来，喝了一杯橙汁。

sentences.en: I took a shower.
sentences.zh: 洗了个澡。

sentences.en: I got dressed.
sentences.zh: 穿好衣服。

sentences.en: I packed my bag for work.
sentences.zh: 收拾好上班的包。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was about to head out.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我正准备出门。

sentences.en: I realized that I hadn't thought about a cigarette the entire morning.
sentences.zh: 我意识到整个早上我都没想过抽烟的事。

sentences.en: I'd literally gone through my entire routine without once thinking about a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 我真的在没想过抽烟的情况下完成了整个例行程序。

sentences.en: And, of course, then I was thinking about a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 当然，在那之后我就开始想抽烟了。

sentences.en: But it was incredible because, for me, by that time, I would have already had a cigarette
sentences.zh: 但这太不可思议了，因为对我来说，在那之前，我早就抽过一根烟了，

sentences.en: and would have been planning to have my next one right as I walked out the door.
sentences.zh: 而且出门时已经在计划下一根了。

sentences.en: However, I've made it this far before.
sentences.zh: 不过，我以前也到过这个阶段。

sentences.en: I quit for about six months when I was 18.
sentences.zh: 我18岁时曾戒过大约六个月。

sentences.en: And last year, I quit for 10 months.
sentences.zh: 去年，我戒了10个月。

sentences.en: So this isn't even the longest I've gone without smoking.
sentences.zh: 所以这甚至不是我戒烟时间最长的一次。

sentences.en: I Google, how many people successfully quit smoking?
sentences.zh: 我谷歌搜索：有多少人成功戒烟？

sentences.en: It says 90% of smokers who try to quit relapse in the first year.
sentences.zh: 上面说90%尝试戒烟的烟民在第一年内会复吸。

sentences.en: The last time I quit, I relapsed on a Black & Mild, one of those 60-cent cigars they sell at gas stations.
sentences.zh: 上次戒烟时，我因为一根 Black & Mild 复吸了，就是加油站卖的那种60美分的雪茄。

sentences.en: I think I've only smoked one other Black & Mild in my life, when I was 16 at a house party.
sentences.zh: 我想我这辈子只抽过另一根 Black & Mild，那是16岁在家庭派对上。

sentences.en: I bought it because they're strong, and you can buy one at a time.
sentences.zh: 我买它是为了劲儿大，而且可以单买。

sentences.en: I thought, if I could just have one really strong cigarette, it'd be enough to last me the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果我能抽上一根劲儿特别大的烟，应该足够我余生受用了。

sentences.en: The next day, I bought a pack of Camel Lights.
sentences.zh: 第二天，我买了一包骆驼淡味香烟。

sentences.en: This time, I know to stay away from Black & Milds.
sentences.zh: 这一次，我知道要远离 Black & Mild。

sentences.en: It's been about a month since I quit smoking, and I'm walking home from work.
sentences.zh: 戒烟大约一个月了，我正下班走回家。

sentences.en: It's cold, but sunny.
sentences.zh: 天气很冷，但阳光明媚。

sentences.en: I'm happy.
sentences.zh: 我很开心。

sentences.en: I see a guy about my age step out of his office and start walking in front of me.
sentences.zh: 我看到一个和我年纪差不多的人走出办公室，开始走在我前面。

sentences.en: He reaches into his coat pocket and puts a cigarette to his mouth.
sentences.zh: 他伸手进外套口袋，把一根烟放到嘴边。

sentences.en: Then he reaches into his other pocket, and I see him do that familiar pause to light up before he starts walking again.
sentences.zh: 然后他伸手进另一个口袋，我看到他像往常一样停顿了一下点火，然后继续走。

sentences.en: The smoke drifts back to me, and I'm just jealous that he's not doing a radio story about quitting smoking.
sentences.zh: 烟雾飘到我这边，我只是嫉妒他不用做关于戒烟的广播故事。

sentences.en: He reminds me of how much I miss the ritual of the after-work cigarette.
sentences.zh: 他让我想起我有多怀念下班后抽烟的仪式感。

sentences.en: I've had a bunch of cravings like this, so I've had to call my friend Larry Hansen in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 我经历过很多次这样的烟瘾，所以我不得不给明尼阿波利斯的朋友 Larry Hansen 打电话。

sentences.en: He's a former smoker, and one of the support people Shunker suggested I line up before quitting.
sentences.zh: 他是一位前烟民，也是 Shunker 建议我在戒烟前联系的支持者之一。

sentences.en: It's like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 就好像，我不知道。

sentences.en: It's like, I wish I could smoke without any of the, like, consequences, you know?
sentences.zh: 就好像，我希望我能抽烟而不用承担任何后果，你懂吗？

sentences.en: But that's magical thinking, Max.
sentences.zh: 但那是幻想，Max。

sentences.en: Don't even go that.
sentences.zh: 别想那个。

sentences.en: Don't even go there.
sentences.zh: 想都别想。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Don't even go there.
sentences.zh: 想都别想。

sentences.en: I mean, that's foolish.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那太愚蠢了。

sentences.en: We can't do it, you know?
sentences.zh: 我们做不到，你懂吗？

sentences.en: It's not in the stars for us.
sentences.zh: 我们命中注定做不到。

sentences.en: I couldn't, you know, light up a cigarette and just say,
sentences.zh: 我不能，你知道，点上一根烟然后说，

sentences.en: Oh, I'll have a cigarette, and I won't have another one for six months or something like that.
sentences.zh: 哦，我就抽这一根，接下来的六个月我都不抽了之类的。

sentences.en: It wouldn't work that way for me, you know?
sentences.zh: 对我来说行不通，你懂吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我肯定。

sentences.en: And I don't want to even experiment and, you know, say,
sentences.zh: 我甚至不想去尝试，然后说，

sentences.en: Oh, would that really happen?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的会那样吗？

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你懂吗？

sentences.en: No, I don't care.
sentences.zh: 不，我不在乎。

sentences.en: I'm not going to try.
sentences.zh: 我不会去试的。

sentences.en: I asked Larry if it was hard for him to quit.
sentences.zh: 我问 Larry 戒烟对他来说是否很难。

sentences.en: You know, I told you how I had tried to quit,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我告诉过你我尝试戒烟的方式，

sentences.en: and I would go buy cigarettes and then smoke one and then flush them down the toilet.
sentences.zh: 我会去买烟，抽上一根，然后把剩下的冲进马桶。

sentences.en: And then, you know, I tried the various things.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我试过各种方法。

sentences.en: I tried tapering off, and then I tried going to smoke low, whatever those, you know,
sentences.zh: 我试过逐渐减量，然后试过抽低焦油的，不管那些，你知道，

sentences.en: they were supposed to be, like, I don't know, diet cigarettes or something like that.
sentences.zh: 它们本应该是，我不知道，减肥烟之类的东西。

sentences.en: Then I asked him what I've been most scared to ask him.
sentences.zh: 然后我问了他我最害怕问的问题。

sentences.en: Does he still miss it?
sentences.zh: 他现在还怀念抽烟吗？

sentences.en: Well, you know, I mean, I feel great now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我的意思是，我现在感觉棒极了。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm, you know, 72 years old, and I haven't smoked for more than 30 years, you know?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，我都72岁了，而且我已经戒烟超过30年了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I know if I were still smoking now, it would, well, I just, I can't imagine it.
sentences.zh: 我知道如果我现在还在抽烟，那……我简直无法想象。

sentences.en: But to answer your question, do I miss it?
sentences.zh: 但回答你的问题，我会怀念抽烟吗？

sentences.en: I don't really, you know?
sentences.zh: 其实不会，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, when I was in Vienna back in November,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，去年11月我在维也纳的时候，

sentences.en: they still allow smoking in some cafes there.
sentences.zh: 那里的一些咖啡馆仍然允许吸烟。

sentences.en: As soon as you walked in the door of the place, it reeked of smoke,
sentences.zh: 你一走进那地方的门，就闻到一股烟味，

sentences.en: and it's just not a pleasant kind of experience.
sentences.zh: 那真不是什么愉快的体验。

sentences.en: And maybe that was a line that I crossed when I used to get a whiff of cigarette smoke,
sentences.zh: 也许这就是我曾经跨过的那道坎，以前我闻到烟味时，

sentences.en: and there would be this pang of remorse, you know?
sentences.zh: 心里会有一种悔恨感，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Or, ooh, that smells good.
sentences.zh: 或者觉得，噢，那味道真香。

sentences.en: I wish I could have a cigarette right now.
sentences.zh: 真希望我现在能抽上一根烟。

sentences.en: And then I've passed that point now, and I, you know, I just go,
sentences.zh: 但现在我已经过了那个阶段，我，你知道，我只会觉得，

sentences.en: oh, what's that smell?
sentences.zh: 噢，那是什么味儿？

sentences.en: It stinks, you know?
sentences.zh: 真臭，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I have not reached that point yet.
sentences.zh: 我还没达到那个阶段。

sentences.en: When I smell a cigarette, it still smells pretty good to me.
sentences.zh: 当我闻到烟味时，对我来说依然觉得挺香的。

sentences.en: But I'm so grateful I don't have to smoke anymore.
sentences.zh: 但我非常庆幸自己不必再抽烟了。

sentences.en: Every time I run, I'm grateful I don't smoke.
sentences.zh: 每次跑步时，我都庆幸自己不抽烟。

sentences.en: I'm grateful I don't have to get up and leave my desk all the time.
sentences.zh: 我庆幸自己不必总是起身离开办公桌。

sentences.en: I'm grateful I don't need a cigarette when I feel stressed or sad or happy.
sentences.zh: 我庆幸自己在感到压力、悲伤或快乐时，不需要一根烟。

sentences.en: I used to smoke every couple hours, every hour on the weekends.
sentences.zh: 我以前每隔几个小时就抽一根，周末甚至每小时都抽。

sentences.en: Last week, I looked up at the clock and couldn't believe how late it was.
sentences.zh: 上周，我抬头看时钟，简直不敢相信时间已经这么晚了。

sentences.en: That rarely happened to me as a smoker, but it happens to me all the time now.
sentences.zh: 我抽烟的时候很少发生这种情况，但现在却经常发生。

sentences.en: It wasn't anything unusual.
sentences.zh: 这没什么特别的。

sentences.en: I cooked dinner with my roommate, we played a few games of cribbage,
sentences.zh: 我和室友一起做了晚饭，玩了几局纸牌游戏，

sentences.en: and we were laughing about something or other as I ate my nightly bowl of cereal.
sentences.zh: 吃着我每晚必吃的麦片粥，我们还聊得很开心。

sentences.en: Before, each of these moments were bookended by a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 以前，这些时刻的前后总少不了一根烟。

sentences.en: Now, I'm just here, present.
sentences.zh: 现在，我就在这里，活在当下。

sentences.en: It's been 186 days without a cigarette, but I'm by no means out of the woods.
sentences.zh: 我已经戒烟186天了，但我绝没有完全脱离危险。

sentences.en: I thought I'd be able to say, I quit smoking.
sentences.zh: 我本以为自己能说出“我戒烟了”这样的话。

sentences.en: But I realize it's not something I get to say yet.
sentences.zh: 但我意识到，我还不能这么说。

sentences.en: I just get to say, I'm not smoking today.
sentences.zh: 我只能说，我今天没抽烟。

sentences.en: But I think one day I'll get to the point where I can go to a beautiful place like Vienna,
sentences.zh: 但我相信总有一天，我会达到那种境界：去维也纳那样美丽的地方，

sentences.en: full of outdoor cafes with strong espresso and ashtrays at every table,
sentences.zh: 那里到处都是露天咖啡馆，有浓郁的意式浓缩咖啡，每张桌子上都有烟灰缸，

sentences.en: and think, those cigarettes?
sentences.zh: 而我只会想，那些烟？

sentences.en: They just stink.
sentences.zh: 真是臭不可闻。

sentences.en: As I listened to Max, I realized one really hard thing about giving up smoking
sentences.zh: 听了马克斯的话，我意识到戒烟最难的一点在于，

sentences.en: is that you don't get to declare victory.
sentences.zh: 你无法宣布自己彻底胜利了。

sentences.en: You don't get to say, okay, I'm done.
sentences.zh: 你不能说，好了，我大功告成了。

sentences.en: The victory is always provisional.
sentences.zh: 胜利总是暂时的。

sentences.en: But recently, I was speaking with Tom Frieden,
sentences.zh: 但最近，我和汤姆·弗里登谈过，

sentences.en: who heads the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the CDC.
sentences.zh: 他是美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）的负责人。

sentences.en: I told him about Max.
sentences.zh: 我跟他说了马克斯的事。

sentences.en: Tom told me that getting to six months is huge.
sentences.zh: 汤姆告诉我，能坚持六个月意义重大。

sentences.en: Turns out, every day you stay off smoking makes it less likely you'll ever go back.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，你坚持不抽烟的每一天，都会让你复吸的可能性降低。

sentences.en: The longer you quit, the longer you quit.
sentences.zh: 戒烟的时间越长，你就越稳固。

sentences.en: Max had one big source of inspiration these last six months
sentences.zh: 过去这六个月里，马克斯有一个巨大的动力来源，

sentences.en: that he isn't going to have going forward.
sentences.zh: 而这个动力在未来将不复存在。

sentences.en: That's you.
sentences.zh: 那就是你们。

sentences.en: Max knew we were going to put together this podcast six months after he stopped smoking,
sentences.zh: 马克斯知道我们打算在他戒烟六个月后制作这期播客，

sentences.en: and he knew lots of you were waiting for it.
sentences.zh: 他也知道你们很多人都在等着听。

sentences.en: He didn't want to tell you he'd failed.
sentences.zh: 他不想告诉你们他失败了。

sentences.en: On the plus side, he's now put away more than $1,000 in that savings account,
sentences.zh: 好消息是，他现在已经在那个储蓄账户里存了超过1000美元，

sentences.en: and he's going to donate all that money to that evil organization
sentences.zh: 如果他复吸的话，他会把这些钱全部捐给那个邪恶的组织。

sentences.en: if he goes back to smoking.
sentences.zh: 如果他复吸的话。

sentences.en: They're going to do terrible things with the money, Max.
sentences.zh: 他们会用这笔钱做坏事的，马克斯。

sentences.en: Awful things.
sentences.zh: 可怕的事情。

sentences.en: Don't let them do it.
sentences.zh: 别让他们得逞。

sentences.en: If you want to help Max, follow him on Twitter at MaxNestrack.
sentences.zh: 如果你想帮助马克斯，请在推特上关注他：MaxNestrack。

sentences.en: He's agreed that if he ever goes back to smoking,
sentences.zh: 他已经同意，如果他哪天复吸了，

sentences.en: he'll announce it the same day publicly on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 他会在当天就在推特上公开宣布。

sentences.en: I know you'll have his back.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们会支持他的。

sentences.en: This episode of Hidden Brain was produced by Maggie Penman and Max Nestrack.
sentences.zh: 本期《Hidden Brain》由玛吉·彭曼和马克斯·内斯特拉克制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Michael May and Jenny Schmidt.
sentences.zh: 由迈克尔·梅和珍妮·施密特编辑。

sentences.en: Our staff also includes Kara McGurk-Allison and Chris Bendereff.
sentences.zh: 我们的团队成员还包括卡拉·麦格克-艾利森和克里斯·本德雷夫。

sentences.en: You can find us on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram,
sentences.zh: 你可以在脸书、推特和Instagram上找到我们，

sentences.en: and listen to my stories on your local public radio station.
sentences.zh: 也可以在你当地的公共广播电台收听我的故事。

sentences.en: If you liked this episode, please consider giving us a review on iTunes
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这一集，请考虑在iTunes或其他任何播客平台上给我们写评论，

sentences.en: or any other podcast platform.
sentences.zh: 或者任何其他播客平台。

sentences.en: It will help other people find the show.
sentences.zh: 这能帮助更多人找到我们的节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam, and this is NPR.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆，这是NPR。
